services_page.title: Our Logistics Services
services_page.description: We are a shipping agency dedicated to integrated logistics services. We transport cars, rolling cargo, containers, and project cargo to connect Argentina with the world.
services_page.routes_desc_1: Our "multipurpose" vessels are designed for the simultaneous loading of containers, project cargo, and cars.
services_page.routes_desc_2: In Argentina, we operate at Terminal Zárate. From there, we connect with key ports in Brazil, Uruguay, Northwest Africa, and Northern Europe, also offering transshipments to extend our routes.

procedures.title: Procedures and Formalities
procedures.description: Consult the requirements for each operation and send your pre-formatted request to the corresponding department.
procedures.p1_desc: Manage the release and delivery of import merchandise arrived at Zárate.
procedures.p1_req1: Presentation of original endorsed BL (or Telex Release LOI)
procedures.p1_req2: Certificate of no debt issued by the agency
procedures.p1_req3: Proof of payment of local charges
procedures.p1_body: Dear Customer Service Team,%0A%0AI request the release of the cargo corresponding to the following data:%0A%0A- BL Number:%0A- Vessel Name:%0A- Voyage:%0A- Consignee (Tax ID):%0A%0AI attach the required documentation (endorsed BL, certificate of no debt, and proof of payment).%0A%0ASincerely,
procedures.p2_desc: Request the issuance and delivery of your Bills of Lading (BL) for export cargo.
procedures.p2_req1: BL matrix approved in the system
procedures.p2_req2: Proof of payment of freight and local charges
procedures.p2_body: Dear Export Documentation Team,%0A%0AI request the issuance of the BLs corresponding to the following data:%0A%0A- Booking Number / Reference:%0A- Vessel Name:%0A- Voyage:%0A- Shipper:%0A%0AI attach proof of freight payment and approved matrix.%0A%0ASincerely,
procedures.p3_desc: Request the physical inspection of units in case of suspected damage prior to withdrawal from Terminal Zárate.
procedures.p3_req1: Presentation of formal Letter of Protest
procedures.p3_req2: Details of alleged damage with initial photographic record
procedures.p3_req3: The unit MUST NOT be removed from the port until the survey is carried out
procedures.p3_body: Dear Claims Team,%0A%0AI request the inspection of the following unit at Terminal Zárate prior to its withdrawal:%0A%0A- BL / Unit Number:%0A- Make / Model / Chassis:%0A- Preliminary detail of the issue:%0A%0AI attach signed Letter of Protest and initial photographic record.%0A%0ASincerely,
procedures.p4_desc: Request the settlement of local charges and freight amounts for invoicing.
procedures.p4_req2: Company Name and Tax ID to be invoiced
procedures.p4_req3: Breakdown or details of required additional services
procedures.p4_body: Dear Finance Team,%0A%0AI request the settlement and invoice for the following data:%0A%0A- BL / Booking Number:%0A- Tax ID to invoice:%0A- Company Name:%0A- Detail of additional services (if applicable):%0A%0ASincerely,
procedures.p5_desc: Report wire transfers made to obtain the official receipt and enable procedures.
procedures.p5_req2: Number of settled invoice being paid
procedures.p5_req3: Client's Tax ID and Company Name
procedures.p5_body: Dear Finance Team,%0A%0AI attach the proof of payment for its corresponding application and receipt issuance:%0A%0A- Canceled Invoice Number:%0A- Transferred amount:%0A- Tax ID / Company Name:%0A- Origin bank:%0A%0AI attach the PDF/image file of the transfer.%0A%0ASincerely,
procedures.p6_desc: Request international freight quotes for containerized merchandise.
procedures.p6_req1: Desired port of origin and port of destination
procedures.p6_req2: Container type and size (20ft, 40ft HC, Reefer, etc.)
procedures.p6_req3: Description of merchandise and estimated gross weight
procedures.p6_body: Dear Container Commercial Team,%0A%0AI request a quote for the following shipment:%0A%0A- Port of Origin:%0A- Port of Destination:%0A- Type / Number of Containers:%0A- Type of Merchandise:%0A- Estimated Gross Weight (kg):%0A- Estimated shipping frequency:%0A%0ASincerely,
procedures.p7_desc: Request freight for motor vehicles, trucks, buses, or self-propelled machinery.
procedures.p7_req1: Make, model, and year of manufacture of the unit
procedures.p7_req2: Exact dimensions (length x width x height in meters)
procedures.p7_req3: Weight in tons and whether the unit rolls under its own power
procedures.p7_body: Dear Ro-Ro Commercial Team,%0A%0AI request a maritime transport quote for the following unit:%0A%0A- Make / Model / Year:%0A- Condition (Rolls under its own power: Yes/No):%0A- Exact dimensions (Length x Width x Height m):%0A- Weight (kg):%0A- Port of Origin:%0A- Port of Destination:%0A%0ASincerely,
procedures.p8_desc: Request rates for oversized, extra-heavy cargo or complex industrial projects.
procedures.p8_req1: Detailed stowage plan or technical sheet of the package
procedures.p8_req2: Identified lifting points and centers of gravity
procedures.p8_req3: Total weight, cradle requirements, or special lashing
procedures.p8_body: Dear Project Cargo Commercial Team,%0A%0AI request a special transport quote for the following project:%0A%0A- Detailed description of the cargo:%0A- Maximum dimensions (Length x Width x Height m):%0A- Total weight (kg):%0A- Special lifting points (Yes/No):%0A- Port of Origin:%0A- Port of Destination:%0A- Estimated project schedule:%0A%0ASincerely,
